clickToAddOrDrag: Click to add, or drag onto the board. Recolour and resize them like any item.
youCanViewThisBoard: You can view this board but not add items.
theIconLibraryCouldnT: The icon library couldn’t load. Check your connection and reopen it.
pickSvgFilesOrA: Pick SVG files, a folder of them or a ZIP.
packAdded: “{name}” is ready: {count, plural, one {# icon} other {# icons}}.
packAddedSomeSkipped: “{name}” is ready: {count, plural, one {# icon} other {# icons}}. {skipped, plural, one {# file wasn’t} other {# files weren’t}} an SVG Freero can draw.
svgIconsYourTeamMay: SVG icons everyone in this workspace can search and place: your design system’s icons, or cloud architecture icons you’re licensed to use.
countFilesChosen: {count, plural, one {# file chosen} other {# files chosen}}
chooseSvgFilesOrA: Choose SVG files or a ZIP
scriptsLinksAndStylesAre: Up to {max, number} icons. Only the drawing is kept: scripts, links and styles are removed. One-colour icons can be recoloured on the board.
iconsAlreadyOnBoardsStay: Icons already placed on boards stay as they are. Nobody can add new ones from this pack.
svgIconsOnlyYou: SVG icons only you can search and place, on any board you open.
